decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the É accent's identical length adjustment, unchanged Option B terminal baseline, and separately softened-corner comparison.

The existing message-195 MODIFY already captures the necessary second-V effect: the minute same-line length increase while preserving the Option B terminal geometry; the separate terminal comparison remains owned by the shared terminal Requirement.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already distinguishes the mechanical same-line length increase from terminal redesign and preserves the required terminal and geometric invariants.

The existing message-195 MODIFY already limits the Hero V geometry change to a minute right-arm length increase and preserves all other geometry; the terminal alternatives are independently represented by the source Requirement.
The source keeps the architecture, proportions, spacing, and finish locked and does not change the current composition, kerning, baseline, or hierarchy requirements.
The terminal comparison concerns the Hero V, second V, and É accent and does not change the construction, proportions, or architectural language of the remaining letterforms.
The source explicitly treats the finish as locked and does not change the preferred Satin Reflection finish or champagne-gold distribution.
The mechanical terminal comparison does not alter the established brand purpose, tone, positioning, symbolism, or precision-and-elegance hierarchy.
Refining the shared terminal does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
The source concerns an in-progress terminal study and does not change the production-ready asset-delivery obligation.
